inlineContent.text: is the new design system unified and cohesive across all platforms to build Orange mobile applications for everyone everywhere. Its objective is to propose a set of guidelines about how to apply the Orange brand on mobile applications. It also provides series of components and modules that show in details how to use this in the Orange apps.
has been implemented in two code repositories:
a SwiftUI code library distributed as a Swift package for all Apple platforms (
that can be launched to show the guidelines, components, and modules (
This demo app also shows how to use the library and style existing components.

Using these resources will help you create Orange-branded applications faster while benefiting from the work done to ensure that all examples meet the brand, ecodesign, open-source, and accessibility requirements.
You can find more details about this design system on the official website,
Orange Unified Design System framework supports iOS / iPadOS 15 and later.
Orange Unified Design System framework focuses first on iOS / iPadOS, but other platforms like macOS, visionOS, watchOS and tvOS are supported.
Feel free to submit pull requests if you can improve the support of any platforms!
The Orange Unified Design System library is a Software Development Kit (SDK) that allows developers to create Orange-branded mobile applications.
this SDK does not handle any personal data
this SDK does not require any device permission to work

Design tokens represent the small, repeated design decisions that make up a design system’s visual style. Tokens wrap hard-coded static values, such as hexadecimal codes for color, with self-explanatory names. They are used to define the look and feel and the style of everything. They are exposed through the themes and can be used as they are.
